TRAINING REPRODUCTION IN THE EXISTING RESEARCH WORKSPACE

The portable bundle reproduces inference and frozen-rule execution. Exact SFT
sources, selected synthetic teacher pairs and optimizer checkpoints are preserved
in the research experiment directory below. They are not needed for CPU serving.
No company raw CSV or private evaluation answers were used in these SFT pairs.

Experiment directory:
  /home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/data/eda/logical_rule_discovery_eval/20261109T182204+0900
Python:
  /home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/.venv/bin/python

Run only in the current Docker container and use an assigned exposed GPU. Check
GPU availability first. Never reuse an output directory or overwrite a checkpoint.
These commands describe a deliberate new training run, not an automatic startup
step. They do not install dependencies or change the pinned original Base.

Selected sources, not an unreviewed regenerated draft
  Phase 1: logical_sft/teacher_verified/{train,validation}.jsonl, manifest.json
  Phase 2: logical_completion_sft/teacher_reviewed/{train,validation}.jsonl,
           manifest.json, review_before_training and training_source_snapshot
The selected JSONL files and their recorded hashes are the authoritative pairs.
Builders and earlier drafts are retained for provenance; rerunning a draft builder
is not permission to substitute different targets or skip their semantic review.
The second manifest also pins the initial logical adapter weight/config.

Inspect these sources and hashes before any GPU run. Use the exact project
interpreter with -B and without -O. Critical gates in the preserved trainer use
assert, so optimized Python is not a supported training execution mode.

Phase 1 CPU token/target admission, from the experiment directory
  '/home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/.venv/bin/python' -B \
    implementation/train_logical_adapter.py \
    --teacher logical_sft/teacher_verified \
    --output /path/to/NEW/phase1_cpu_admission --cpu-only

Phase 1 deliberate GPU training
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<assigned-id> \
    '/home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/.venv/bin/python' -B \
    implementation/train_logical_adapter.py \
    --teacher logical_sft/teacher_verified --output /path/to/NEW/phase1_training

Phase 2 deliberate GPU training, if this phase was selected in selection_evidence
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<assigned-id> \
    '/home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/.venv/bin/python' -B \
    implementation/train_logical_completion_adapter.py \
    --teacher logical_completion_sft/teacher_reviewed \
    --warmstart logical_sft/training/checkpoints/final/adapter \
    --output /path/to/NEW/phase2_training
The reviewed second-phase manifest pins the actual original first-phase adapter.
It will reject a different newly reproduced adapter unless a separate prospective
dataset/initialization review creates a new manifest. Never rewrite the preserved
selected manifest to make a different weight silently pass.

Independent post-run audits
  '/home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/.venv/bin/python' -B \
    implementation/audit_logical_training.py \
    --training /path/to/NEW/phase1_training --teacher logical_sft/teacher_verified \
    --output /path/to/NEW/phase1_audit
  '/home/msko20702/#종합설계/data/.venv/bin/python' -B \
    implementation/audit_logical_completion_training.py \
    --training /path/to/NEW/phase2_training \
    --teacher logical_completion_sft/teacher_reviewed \
    --output /path/to/NEW/phase2_audit

Training protocol
NF4 double-quantized original Base, BF16 compute; language-module LoRA rank8,
alpha16, dropout0.05; 23,760,896 trainable parameters in 608 adapter tensors.
Only assistant answer and EOS tokens contribute to cross-entropy; source prompt
tokens are masked. AdamW at1e-4, accumulation4, gradient clip1, seed42, maximum
sequence8192 with no truncation. Base and vision parameters remain frozen.

Phase 1 selected264 train/66 validation, one full66-step epoch from the Base.
Phase 2 selected336 train/84 validation, one additional84-step epoch from the
first adapter with a fresh optimizer. The previous264/66 pairs are copied byte
for byte;72 train/18 validation pairs add conditional independent requirements,
permission-versus-obligation and authority-versus-observational-role examples.
Across both phases the old264 training pairs are exposed twice and the new72
once. This is not two full epochs over336 independent examples. Validation
families overlap training families; exact input hashes do not overlap splits.

Record complete sample consumption, finite adapter tensors, actual changes and
unchanged protected on-disk sources. NLL and executor admission do not establish
generation quality. Re-run source-only generation and fixed behavioral tests,
preserving invalid attempts and first/final results. Do not put those evaluation
answers or failed model outputs into the selected SFT data without a new study.
The release selection is explicit; a later adapter is not adopted automatically.

Checkpoint recovery
The final selected history may include an optimizer-boundary recovery into a new
directory after the client execution session stopped. The unchanged trainer then
restores AdamW and Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG states. Effective consumed-example
records up to that checkpoint are copied exactly once. Later interrupted updates
are preserved separately and excluded from the selected weight lineage. A full
epoch claim concerns the effective checkpoint lineage, not uninterrupted execution
or a claim that no discarded compute occurred. A recovered training_result.json
seconds field covers its resumed execution only; see selected_training_history.json
for original attempts and copied-ledger accounting.

Selected synthetic JSONL files are included under training_data for inspection.
Preserved manifests intentionally retain original workspace paths and warmstart pins.
Parent adapter weights/Base and the experiment trainer are external prerequisites.
This is an inference/serving bundle, not an automatic standalone retraining package.
